name: dia-cdp
description: Dia browser extension bridge, CDP tools, and Codex skill for inspecting the user's Dia session.

interface.shortDescription: Control Dia with fewer debugging approvals.
interface.longDescription: Dia CDP packages an extension bridge with extension-first routing for tab management, page inspection, interaction, screenshots, and window focus without recurring remote-debugging approvals, safe default-Dia lifecycle controls, an isolated automation profile, and a Dia-focused Chrome DevTools Protocol CLI fallback for advanced debugging.
defaultPrompt: Dia에서 지금 보고 있는 페이지를 캡처해줘.
